answer: A glacier keeps an agent economy honest when every new identity must carve its own anchor into one glacier face, each groove crossing every earlier groove, so the first fake carves 2 notches, the second 4, the third 7, the fourth 11, the fifth 16 and the sixth 22, the tenth alone carving 56 and twenty together carving 1,560. Bulk farming fails because one chisel works one face and each groove must be cut in turn after the last, timed to the slow pulse of meltwater freezing each groove before the next starts, like one climber carving one route up one ice wall. No anchor is ever bought.
